intro.text: Brightlady Jayla Ruthar, an Alethi noblewoman and wife of Highprince Ruthar.

items.text: Jayla lived on the Shattered Plains during the war there. She attended a meeting at the Pinnacle with other Alethi nobles to discuss the threat of the Assassin in White.

personality.text: Jasnah Kholin thinks Jayla and her husband thieving and dangerous. They are usually political allies of Torol and Ialai Sadeas, who use them for their ambition.
